body:
At frozen7800b014 the ordinary canonicalizer still explicitly reserves `Result<Option<Rc<OrderedWeights>>, Diagnostic>` on every uncached `closure` request before calling `closure_inner`. OPT839 removes the warm authentication inner Result only; this is a separate real producer boundary.

Implement a paid invocation-owned closure receiving slot and a true unit-returning `closure_inner_into` producer. Remove the old receiver reservation only when the corresponding Result constructor is actually gone. Do not rewrap the existing Result call or reinterpret an unrelated fee as savings.

A proposed slot contains separate ready, value and refusal fields. Preserve arithmetic `None` as non-equivalence, distinct from both unset and failure. Fund every new carrier/bootstrap/Option/reference/publication constructor before acquisition. Preserve the compatibility outer Result, scratch-preparation Result, root usize receiver and nested budget Results while they still exist.

Preserve exact function/budget/ledger ownership, all six Diagnostic fields, sticky first failure, floors, work/cursor order, exact existing memo invalidation branches, and final-owner Drop. Keep the complete immediate old receiver independently compiled, full source inverses, original historical joins and original runtime-stage JSON domains. No cap/profile/fuel changes or baseline padding.

Minimum focused controls: exact/one-short/zero and every work frontier; cold/repeated/foreign/restored owner and failure cases; success/arithmetic-None/failure distinction; same canonical IDs/verdicts; precise ordinary-vs-held actual allocations/debits/peak and Drop; complete old-source ownership controls. Coordinate parent signature edits with OPT842's successor representation; its storage changes are a separate scope.

Measure actual closure misses before attributing benefit. One closure_inner invocation may populate many memo entries, so memo insertion counts cannot be presented as eliminated receiver counts. The new one-time slot/bootstrap cost can offset savings at low miss counts. Current frequency, cap recovery and agent-token/cost improvement are unmeasured. A static design exists; no implementation or runtime result is claimed by this issue.
title: (OPT) Reuse a paid invocation receiver for cold canonical closure production
